title: euphrasia rostkoviana subsp. hirtella
intro: Euphrasia rostkoviana subsp. hirtella, commonly known as the Alpine Eyebright, is a flowering plant species belonging to the family Orobanchaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, particularly in relieving eye inflammation, respiratory issues, and gastrointestinal problems. The therapeutic actions of the Alpine Eyebright include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its medicinal value.
